prompt: These images are mel spectrograms: each spans exactly 10 seconds from left to right and shows the strongest 64-mel-bin frequency region, with brighter color meaning more energy. Dark right padding means the recording ended. Every image comes from a bird recording. Box every visible compact tonal, contoured, or vertical bird song or call, even if faint. Exclude wind, rain, microphone handling, broad full-height clicks, insects, and diffuse background noise. Prefer broad phrase-level boxes: combine nearby syllables and use at most 8 boxes per Picture. Use an empty array only when no bird-like structure is visible. Coordinates must be integers on a 0-1000 scale in [left, top, right, bottom] order, where top is high frequency. Return one JSON property per Picture, keyed by its one-based Picture number; each value is an array of boxes.
